notes: Database maintenance: the Backups modal can now restore a snapshot (the current database is swapped out, a .prerestore safety copy is kept, and encrypted snapshots ask for their password). Settings gained a Database card with live health info, one-click integrity checks and a compact (VACUUM) action, plus auto daily snapshots with a keep count (default 14) that are planned from the main process and pruned automatically. Backups are now integrity-checked and optimized after every snapshot, and the database is optimized and checkpointed on quit.
